SELECT a.project_application_sq AS applicationSq, r.resume_nm AS resumeNm, r.resume_ttl AS resumeTtl, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, c.career_start_dt, IFNULL(c.career_end_dt, CURDATE()))),0) FROM TBL_RESUME_CAREER_S c WHERE c.resume_sq = r.resume_sq) AS careerYear, a.project_application_member_type_cd AS memberTypeCd, c.company_nm AS companyNm, a.read_application_dtm AS readResumeDt, a.project_application_created_at_dtm AS appDt, a.selected_interview_dtm AS interviewDt, cc.common_code_nm AS appStatus FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H a JOIN TBL_RESUME_M r ON a.resume_sq = r.resume_sq LEFT JOIN TBL_COMPANY_S c ON a.company_sq = c.company_sq JOIN TBL_COMMON_CODE_C cc ON a.project_application_status_cd = cc.common_code_sq WHERE a.project_sq = #{projectSq} AND a.project_application_member_type_cd = 301
AND cc.common_code_nm = '합격' AND cc.common_code_nm = '지원중' AND cc.common_code_nm = '인터뷰확정' AND cc.common_code_nm = '인터뷰요청중' AND cc.common_code_nm IN ('불합격', '지원취소')
AND LOWER(r.resume_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RESUME_SKILL_TAG_S st JOIN TBL_SKILL_TAG_C s ON st.skill_tag_sq = s.skill_tag_sq WHERE st.resume_sq = r.resume_sq AND LOWER(s.skill_tag_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') ) AND ( LOWER(r.resume_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RESUME_SKILL_TAG_S st JOIN TBL_SKILL_TAG_C s ON st.skill_tag_sq = s.skill_tag_sq WHERE st.resume_sq = r.resume_sq AND LOWER(s.skill_tag_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') ) )
ORDER BY a.project_application_created_at_dtm DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

AND cc.common_code_nm = '합격' AND cc.common_code_nm = '지원중' AND cc.common_code_nm = '인터뷰확정' AND cc.common_code_nm = '인터뷰요청중' AND cc.common_code_nm IN ('불합격', '지원취소')
AND LOWER(r.resume_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RESUME_SKILL_TAG_S st JOIN TBL_SKILL_TAG_C s ON st.skill_tag_sq = s.skill_tag_sq WHERE st.resume_sq = r.resume_sq AND LOWER(s.skill_tag_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') ) AND ( LOWER(r.resume_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RESUME_SKILL_TAG_S st JOIN TBL_SKILL_TAG_C s ON st.skill_tag_sq = s.skill_tag_sq WHERE st.resume_sq = r.resume_sq AND LOWER(s.skill_tag_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') ) )

SELECT a.project_application_sq AS applicationSq, r.resume_nm AS resumeNmTtlVo_resumeNm, r.resume_ttl AS resumeNmTtlVo_resumeTtl, (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, c.career_start_dt, IFNULL(c.career_end_dt, CURDATE())) / 12)), 0) FROM TBL_RESUME_CAREER_S c WHERE c.resume_sq = r.resume_sq) AS careerYear, a.read_application_dtm AS appStatusVo_readResumeDt, a.project_application_created_at_dtm AS appStatusVo_appDt, a.selected_interview_dtm AS appStatusVo_interviewDt, CASE a.project_application_status_cd WHEN 801 THEN '지원중' WHEN 802 THEN '불합격' WHEN 803 THEN '합격' WHEN 804 THEN '인터뷰요청중' WHEN 805 THEN '인터뷰확정' WHEN 806 THEN '지원취소' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS appStatusVo_appStatus FROM TBL_PROJECT_APPLICATION_H a JOIN TBL_RESUME_M r ON a.resume_sq = r.resume_sq JOIN TBL_COMPANY_S c ON a.company_sq = c.company_sq WHERE a.project_sq = #{projectSq} AND c.company_nm = #{companyNm}
AND a.project_application_status_cd = 803 AND a.project_application_status_cd = 801 AND a.project_application_status_cd = 805 AND a.project_application_status_cd = 804 AND a.project_application_status_cd IN (802, 806)
AND LOWER(r.resume_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RESUME_SKILL_TAG_S st JOIN TBL_SKILL_TAG_C s ON st.skill_tag_sq = s.skill_tag_sq WHERE st.resume_sq = r.resume_sq AND LOWER(s.skill_tag_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') ) AND ( LOWER(r.resume_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_RESUME_SKILL_TAG_S st JOIN TBL_SKILL_TAG_C s ON st.skill_tag_sq = s.skill_tag_sq WHERE st.resume_sq = r.resume_sq AND LOWER(s.skill_tag_nm) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') ) )
ORDER BY a.project_application_created_at_dtm DESC
